messages:
Erica Park: Heads-up — planning a small deploy to adjust the capacity signaling for the dedicated GPU pools (aim: reduce noisy scale-ups from short bursts). Target pool: dedicated-gpu-east-1a. Plan to push a config tweak + quick canary. Who can own the deploy?

Jordan K: I can take the deploy. I’ll do the canary on 2 nodes first, then roll to the rest if metrics look stable. ETA ~ 20m after go.

Samir Patel: Thanks. Can you paste the smoke checklist? I’ll be on-call for the window and will watch autoscaler/queue alerts.

Jordan K: Smoke checklist (quick):
- verify canary nodes come up healthy
- no surge in OOMs or pod restarts
- latency p50/p95 for inference routes unchanged (<5% delta)
- queue_depth and scale events sanity check

Luis Gomez: Add a check for cache hit ratio and KV cache sizes; last time we saw evictions that triggered scaling. Also bump-alert thresholds for the first 10m to avoid noise.

Jordan K: Good call. I’ll add temporary alert silencing and a short threshold increase.

Erica Park: Config snippet we’ll apply (will run as a canary first):
```yaml
autoscaler:
  metric: queue_depth
  target: 120        # lowered target to be less aggressive
  evaluation_window: 60
  cooldown: 90
  max_scale_step: 2
```

Jordan K: Deploy steps I’ll run:
1) run preflight: `./tools/preflight.sh --pool dedicated-gpu-east-1a --check-alerts`
2) apply canary config to 2 nodes
3) monitor dashboards for 10m
4) roll remaining nodes with 2m spacing

Samir Patel: Preflight output please. I’ll verify dashboards and keep the rollback command handy.

Jordan K: Preflight output looks clean. Commands run: `./tools/preflight.sh --pool dedicated-gpu-east-1a` returned OK, no pending draining nodes.

devops-bot: Deploy scheduled by Jordan K for thread 1802345678 — canary -> gradual rollout.

Luis Gomez: Rollback plan: revert to previous autoscaler config file and `kubectl apply -f autoscaler-prev.yaml` + re-enable previous alert thresholds. Estimate ~5-7m to converge.

Erica Park: Monitoring hooks: Samir, please watch `infra.autoscaler.scale_events`, `infra.gpu.queue_depth`, `backend.inference.latency_p95`. If we see sustained scale > 3x within 5m or lat p95 increase > 10% on relevant routes, initiate rollback.

Samir Patel: Got it. I’ll have runbook open and will mark a :warning: if anything odd. I’ll also watch the canary nodes specifically (node IDs will be posted).

Jordan K: Canary done: nodes gpu-e1a-canary-1, gpu-e1a-canary-2. Initial metrics: queue_depth down ~8%, scale events at baseline, p95 unchanged. Moving to staged rollout now.

Erica Park: Affirmative. Keep us posted. If anything looks weird, pause and we’ll revert.

Jordan K: Staged rollout complete. No regressions seen in the 20m post-rollout window. I left the temporary alert threshold changes in place for 30m per Luis’s suggestion.

Luis Gomez: I’ll revert the silencing/thresholds after 30m and run the eviction check job.

Samir Patel: All green from on-call. No OOMs, no surge in restarts, latency stable.

Erica Park: Thanks team — closing the loop:
- Owner: Jordan K (deploy)
- Smoke verified: Samir Patel
- SRE checks: Luis Gomez
- Rollback ready and documented: yes

Jordan K: Adding a short postmortem note in the release doc with the config diff and metrics.

Erica Park: Nice work. :tada:
